title_en: AaH2 Alpha-Toxin vs Voltage-Gated Sodium Channel (Site 3 Inactivation Trapping)
title_ar: سم AaH2 النمطي ضد قناة الصوديوم المرتبطة بالجهد (احتجاز موقع 3 ومنع الإخماد)

target.target_name_en: Voltage-Gated Sodium Channel Nav1.2 / Nav1.7 (SCN2A / SCN9A)
target.target_name_ar: قناة الصوديوم المرتبطة بالجهد Nav1.2 / Nav1.7
target.binding_pocket: Receptor Site 3 (Voltage-Sensing Domain IV / VSD4 S3-S4 extracellular loop)
target.cellular_component: Neuronal plasma membrane / Axon initial segment

structural_evidence.evidence_badge_ar: الفئة A: معقد محدد تجريبياً بالمجهر الإلكتروني البرودي (3.50 Å)

docking_workflow.protonation_state: PropKa 3.1 at pH 7.4 (Arg62 protonated +1, Asp669 deprotonated -1)
docking_workflow.solvent_model: GBSA implicit solvent / Amber ff14SB force field

poses.provenance: AutoDock Vina suboptimal cluster with inverted loop orientation

key_target_residues.role: Aromatic stacking partner on S3-S4 loop
Primary electrostatic salt-bridge partner to Arg62

contact_types: Salt bridge: AaH2-Arg62 to Nav-Asp669 (3.2 A)
Aromatic edge-to-face packing: AaH2-Tyr42 into Nav-VSD4 hydrophobic cleft
Steric hindrance: Rigid scaffold prevents outward translation of S4 voltage-sensor segment

experimental_reality_check.electrophysiology_endpoint: Inactivation deceleration (tau prolonged from 1.2 ms to >15 ms at +10 mV)
experimental_reality_check.assay_system: Whole-cell patch-clamp in HEK293 cells & Two-electrode voltage clamp in Xenopus oocytes
experimental_reality_check.docking_score_separation_note: The docking score (-9.6 kcal/mol) cannot be converted to Kd without calibrated thermodynamic models. Docking evaluates static contact energies; the nanomolar experimental Kd reflects unfavorable conformational entropy compensated by deep hydrophobic burial and salt-bridge solvation.

scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.directly_shows: The 3.5 A cryo-EM map demonstrates physical contact between AaH2 and the extracellular S3-S4 loop of domain IV (VSD4), placing Arg62 within 3.2 A of Asp669 and burying Tyr42 in the sensor groove.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.computationally_hypothesized: Docking algorithms predict favorable electrostatic complementarity (-9.6 kcal/mol) and hypothesize that removing the C-terminal Arg62 would drastically lower the score.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.experimentally_measured: Radioligand competition assays measure Kd = 1.2 nM. Patch-clamp electrophysiology proves that binding specifically retards fast inactivation without shifting the activation voltage.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.remains_unknown: The exact kinetic trajectory through which AaH2 partitions from bulk aqueous phase across the outer leaflet to reach membrane-embedded VSD4, and whether membrane PIP2 lipids directly modulate the complex.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.falsification_experiment: A charge-reversal double-mutant cycle: AaH2-Arg62Glu paired with Nav1.7-Asp669Lys should restore nanomolar affinity and inactivation trapping if the salt bridge is obligatory.

epistemic_warnings: DOCKING SCORE GUARD: -9.6 kcal/mol is a scoring-function value, NOT an experimental binding free energy (Delta G_exp) and NOT a measured Kd.
PROXIMITY LIMITATION: Docking proximity does not equal channel modulation. A molecule can dock with high score to closed or inactivated states without causing functional block.
MEMBRANE ABSENCE: In silico docking was performed without the dynamic phospholipid bilayer; physiological membrane partitioning is omitted.

title_en: Charybdotoxin & Kaliotoxin vs Voltage-Gated Potassium Channel (Pore Selectivity Occlusion)
title_ar: سم شريبدوستوكسين وكاليوستوكسين ضد قناة البوتاسيوم Kv1.3 (سد مرشح الانتقائية المركزي)

target.binding_pocket: Outer Vestibule & Selectivity Filter (TTVGYGD signature sequence)

structural_evidence.evidence_badge_ar: الفئة A: معقد محدد تجريبياً بحيود الأشعة السينية (2.50 Å)

docking_workflow.protonation_state: Lys27 protonated (+1 NH3+ mimicking dehydrated K+)

key_peptide_residues.role: Canonical pore cork inserting into selectivity filter S1 site
Electrostatic steering to channel outer turret
Aromatic capping of outer pore entrance
Hydrogen bonding to pore loop carbonyl

contact_types: Direct pore corking: Lys27 epsilon-ammonium coordinates with four Gly374 carbonyl oxygens
Steric occlusion: 100% blockage of potassium ion permeation pathway

experimental_reality_check.electrophysiology_endpoint: IC50 = 0.65 nM (Kaliotoxin) / 2.5 nM (ChTX) on human T-lymphocyte Kv1.3 currents
experimental_reality_check.assay_system: Whole-cell patch clamp in activated human memory T-cells (TEM)
experimental_reality_check.docking_score_separation_note: Direct pore occlusion provides a rare case where docking pose geometry closely explains binary functional block, yet the -11.2 kcal/mol docking score fails to predict the 4-fold subtype selectivity difference between Kv1.1, Kv1.2, and Kv1.3.

scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.directly_shows: Atomic resolution crystal structure (2.5 A) shows Lys27 inserting directly into the pore axis, physically replacing the dehydrated K+ ion at position S1.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.computationally_hypothesized: Molecular mechanics predicts that mutation of Lys27 to Gln would retain shape complementarity but reduce electrostatic stabilization by ~6 kcal/mol.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.experimentally_measured: Electrophysiological patch-clamp confirms IC50 = 0.65 nM in human T cells. Lys27Ala mutation increases IC50 by >10,000-fold without affecting peptide folding.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.remains_unknown: Coupling between toxin binding and the conformational dynamics of slow C-type channel inactivation in intact cell membranes.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.falsification_experiment: Single-channel patch-clamp recording showing all-or-none conductance transitions (12 pS to 0 pS) with single-molecule residence times matching k_off = 0.05 s^-1.

epistemic_warnings: SUBTYPE SELECTIVITY WARNING: Docking scores for ChTX against Kv1.1, Kv1.2, and Kv1.3 differ by < 0.5 kcal/mol in standard force fields, despite 100-fold differences in pharmacological potency.
REVERSIBILITY: Docking does not compute unbinding kinetics (k_off). A high docking score can occur for an irreversible binder or a rapid reversible competitor.

title_en: Wasabi Receptor Toxin (WaTx) vs TRPA1 (Intracellular Allosteric Gating)
title_ar: سم مستقبل الواسابي (WaTx) ضد مستقبل TRPA1 (تنشيط غير ألمي عبر موقع تجويفي داخل خلوي)

target.binding_pocket: Intracellular allosteric nexus (cytosolic S1-S4 linker pocket)

structural_evidence.evidence_class: Class B: Computationally Predicted Docking Model
structural_evidence.evidence_badge_en: Class B: Computational Model / Free Toxin Class A
structural_evidence.evidence_badge_ar: الفئة B: نموذج إرساء تنبؤي / الببتيد الحر فئة A
structural_evidence.experimental_method: Solution NMR (free peptide) + Cryo-EM (receptor) + In-silico docking model

poses.label_ar: بنية السم الحر تجريبياً بالرنين المغناطيسي (6OFA)
poses.provenance: Experimental Solution NMR coordinates from RCSB PDB 6OFA

contact_types: Non-canonical intracellular entry: Penetrates lipid bilayer without pore lysis
Allosteric lock: Binds cytosolic nexus, stabilizing sub-conductance open state without acute pain behavior

experimental_reality_check.electrophysiology_endpoint: EC50 = 1.3 uM (Whole-cell patch clamp and Ca2+ imaging in HEK293-TRPA1)
experimental_reality_check.assay_system: Calcium microfluorometry & patch-clamp in wild-type vs TRPA1-KO dorsal root ganglion neurons
experimental_reality_check.docking_score_separation_note: The docking model was guided by alanine-scanning mutagenesis. The -8.8 kcal/mol score is an illustrative computational metric; the genuine discovery was the unique cell-penetrating non-lytic biological mechanism.

scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.directly_shows: The 6OFA NMR structure resolves the free helical hairpin scaffold. It does NOT resolve the bound state with TRPA1.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.computationally_hypothesized: Computational docking predicts insertion into the intracellular S1-S4 allosteric nexus rather than the extracellular pore vestibule.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.experimentally_measured: EC50 = 1.3 uM channel activation, complete loss of action in TRPA1-/- knockout mice, membrane translocation verified by confocal microscopy without dye leakage.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.remains_unknown: The exact co-crystallographic or cryo-EM electron density map of full-length TRPA1 with bound WaTx in a lipid nanodisc.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.falsification_experiment: Cryo-EM single-particle reconstruction of reconstituted human TRPA1 in complex with synthetic WaTx.

epistemic_warnings: COMPLEX PROVENANCE: The complex is a Class B computational model. The 6OFA PDB entry contains ONLY the isolated peptide, not the receptor.
CELL PENETRATION: Docking simulations cannot predict trans-bilayer translocation; membrane permeation was demonstrated empirically.

title_en: Stigmurin vs Bacterial Lipid II Precursor (Computational Hypothesis Benchmark)
title_ar: ببتيد ستيغمورين ضد طليعة الجدار البكتيري Lipid II (معيار الفرضية الحاسوبية البحتة)

target.target_name_ar: مركب ليبيد 2 الطليعي لبناء جدار الخلية البكتيرية
target.binding_pocket: Pyrophosphate-MurNAc moiety at cytoplasmic membrane interface

structural_evidence.evidence_class: Class B: Computationally Predicted Docking Model
structural_evidence.evidence_badge_ar: الفئة B: فرضية حاسوبية بحتة دون إثبات مخبري

primary_publication.citation: Literature in-silico hypothesis; experimental assays: Amorim-Carmo et al., Int J Mol Sci 2019; 20(3):623

docking_workflow.protonation_state: C-terminal amidated (+2 net charge at pH 7.4)

contact_types: Hypothesized ionic coordination between Lys sidechains and lipid pyrophosphate oxygen atoms

experimental_reality_check.radioligand_binding_kd: UNMEASURED (Zero direct binding evidence; Kd is non-existent in literature)
experimental_reality_check.electrophysiology_endpoint: Antimicrobial MIC = 1.25 ug/mL (0.69 uM) against S. aureus ATCC 29213
experimental_reality_check.assay_system: Broth microdilution & SYTOX Green dye influx fluorometry
experimental_reality_check.docking_score_separation_note: CRITICAL EDUCATIONAL DEMONSTRATION: The -8.4 kcal/mol score is an in-silico artifact of placing a cationic peptide next to an anionic pyrophosphate in a vacuum. It provides ZERO proof of Lipid II binding. The verified experimental mechanism of Stigmurin is non-specific cytoplasmic membrane permeabilization (SYTOX Green positive).

scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.directly_shows: There is NO experimental complex structure. AlphaFold provides a predicted monomer segment.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.computationally_hypothesized: The docking hypothesis claims coordination to Lipid II pyrophosphate with a score of -8.4 kcal/mol.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.experimentally_measured: Antibacterial MIC = 1.25 ug/mL, qualitative SYTOX Green dye uptake (membrane lysis). No binding assay performed.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.remains_unknown: Whether Stigmurin ever physically interacts with Lipid II in a living bacterial cell or whether lysis occurs purely via lipid matrix disruption.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.falsification_experiment: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) or Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) using Lipid II-doped liposomes vs pure DOPG liposomes.

epistemic_warnings: ZERO DIRECT BINDING EVIDENCE: The -8.4 kcal/mol score MUST NOT be cited as a binding affinity (Kd) or proof of mechanism.
MEMBRANE LYSIS CONFOUNDER: Phenotypic bacterial killing (MIC) is completely explained by membrane permeabilization, not single-receptor target engagement.

title_en: TOPI1 vs Bovine Trypsin (Protease Inhibitor Complex Reference)
title_ar: مثبط TOPI1 ضد إنزيم التريبسين البقري (معقد مثبط الإنزيمات المحكّم مخبرياً)

target.binding_pocket: Catalytic triad active site (His57, Asp102, Ser195)

structural_evidence.evidence_badge_ar: الفئة A: معقد بلوري عالي الدقة (1.80 Å)

primary_publication.citation: Mourao et al., J. Med. Chem. 2020; 63(17):9500-9511

key_peptide_residues.role: P1 substrate mimic inserting into Asp189 specificity pocket

key_target_residues.role: S1 specificity pocket anchor coordinating Arg4

contact_types: Active site occlusion: Arg4 fits snugly into the S1 pocket, mimicking an ideal substrate without cleavage

experimental_reality_check.radioligand_binding_kd: Ki = 12.4 nM (Enzyme kinetics with chromogenic substrate BAPNA)
experimental_reality_check.docking_score_separation_note: Provides a classical benchmark where high-resolution structural coordinates (1.80 A) perfectly align with biochemical Ki inhibition constants.

scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.directly_shows: The 1.80 A X-ray structure directly shows TOPI1 reactive loop bound in the trypsin active site with Arg4 inserted in the S1 pocket.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.computationally_hypothesized: In-silico calculations suggest the cyclized backbone confers stability against proteolytic digestion by the target.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.experimentally_measured: Ki = 12.4 nM against bovine trypsin; resistant to thermal denaturation up to 80 deg C.
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.remains_unknown: In vivo selectivity against human serine proteases (thrombin, factor Xa, elastase).
scientific_interpretation_5_pillars.falsification_experiment: Arg4Ala mutation to test if S1 pocket insertion is the sole driver of nanomolar inhibition.

epistemic_warnings: OFF-TARGET RISKS: Potent trypsin inhibition does not imply pharmaceutical safety; indiscriminate serine protease inhibition can cause systemic coagulopathies.
